book.name: Yoan
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Yoan byex o

content: Yesu teyoxe Nikodimas
De tambiy wei Parisi yo ti lei Nikodimas, inyon gyovaxa wei kanzol wei xel Yudayeiw o ti.

Moxo lam wou Yesu eivek boukeing me neil wou, “Putoung, xa woulek bei wang on putoung tiwei Anutu wong e lam o. Wangwei Anutu se mendei is xelti on tyek se bong dee wei lulvako yo nambei ingwei wang mi wong on.”
Yesu neil elox wou e bei, “A neil wou wang zonghek, xelti embei se dumbek no on tyek se gyei Anutu xe tete lalei.”
Nikodimas teling, “Nambei nya tambiy dumbek no gyeik ingwei wo teiv takwei yo? Neing ayang moxo tyek se nox me na eivek ta veis luyuw me dumbek no!”
Yesu lewexe bei, “A neil wou wang zonghek, xelti embei se dumbek en memiing me Laweeng Vambuing on tyek se na eivek Anutu xe tete lalei.
Lul wei neing wong e umbek eno inyon neing, de lul wei Laweeng Vambuing wong e umbek eno inyon laweeng.
Wa seng detek en a xe qayeeng, ‘Qe wang dumbek no.’

De laweeng mi vei me la danghei danghei wei embei na yo. Eno wang mi ngo nindenduing, ekom wa seng woulek bei e lam anghei inya o embei na nya. Om inyon teyei lek xel dalus wei umbek vako en Laweeng Vambuing o.”
Nikodimas teling, “Lulti yon tyek bong ambei nya?”
Yesu neil wou, “Wa Israelyeiw xe putoung, ekom wa seng woulek lulti beimambei ne?
A neil wou wang zonghek, xa luk en vati wei xa woulek o, me xa neil qayeeng en vati wei xa xei woy yo, ekom xam xomaxoneing seng wongis xa xe qayeeng.
A neil wou xam en lul wei tembuing o ekom xam seng wongis, woyom wangwei a neil wou xam en lul wei tyoung gheyapu yo on tyek xam ghe bongis ambei nya?
Xelti se la eivek tyoung gheyapu ti qe tambiy tiwei lam anghei tyoung gheyapu nei yo, inyon Xomaxoneing Neu Moux.
Inye nambei Mose zeim myeiy lek la eivek tembuing bandaing o, om Xomaxoneing Neu Moux eno tyek xel a zeim e zekna,
om xel dalus wei embei bongis e eno tyek na qou deing mapieing luta luta.
“En Anutu lalei vind xomaxoneing wei tembuing sapa yo omek wong emaxow Neu Moux tixemou tateis on, en kandek eti yeiw wei wongis e eno se mey, qe xel a qou deing mapieing luta luta.
En Anutu se wong Neu Moux lam lek tembuing bei e nam bong qayeeng en xomaxoneing lek tembuing. Qe wong e lam bei e nam devind xomaxoneing wei tembuing sapa veil meyeing.
Eti yeiw wei wongis moxo eno se nale lek qayeeng, qe eti yeiw wei se wongis e eno nale lek qayeeng woy. En nambei se wongis Anutu Neu Moux tixemou tateis on lei.
Xel xe qayeeng on qes ambei nye, xeiyaing lam eivek tembuing, ekom xomaxoneing laleind vind mapetok ghanaw xeiyaing en nambei xel xe kwa yon nilul.
Xomaxoneing sapa wei mi wo kwa nilul eno mi pesek xeiyaing, om xel embei se nam eivek xeiyaing, en tyek xel xe kwa nilul on nam yanyateiv.
Ekom eti yeiw wei mi betiwou kwa wei zonghek eno mi lam eivek xeiyaing en kandek xel gyei embo nimza bei lulul wei xel mi wong eno xel mi wong xuk en Anutu xe nikanzek.”
Yoan lipekeing neil Yesu teyei no
Ka tine la veil, eno Yesu lis e xe xel betiyeing la danghei wei Yudia nei. Moxo toundei is xel anghei inyon me lipek moux alis vex.
Yoan lipek xomaxoneing is ambei nyon nanghei Ainon paviy beyeeng Salim, en nambei memiing ngenong di yeip inyon, me xomaxoneing di lam bei e zipek xel.
Inyon atax gyeik xel se ghei toung Yoan eivek xeitueing o.
Xel betiyeing wei Yoan o valu is Yuda ti pyalek ama en kwa wei xel mi lipek me wo vako wou Anutu manghalus o.
Yoan xe xel betiyeing lam neil wou e bei, “Putoung, tambiy tiwei toundei is wang anghei memiing Yorodan loxalu nei me wang neil e xe qayeeng, eno di lipek moux alis vex, me xel dalus la wou e.”
Yoan neil elox wou xel bei, “Tambiy ti teyei bei qou vatiyeiw, wangwei Anutu wei tyoung gheyapu nei bong wou e yo.
Xam venaxow a neil teyei en qayeeng wei a neil o bei, ‘A se Kilisi, qe a tambiy tiwei Anutu wong a lam atax en e yo.’
Tambiy ti dii vex ti eno vex tiyon e venei. De e xe gweleeng mi nale me li nenya wou tambiy wei ii vex o xe lukeing me wo xeilala ngandoung. Om gweimbeeng xeilala tiyon eno pup eivek a laleing.
Moxo lei e zekna gheyapu, de a leing e deteiwou.

“Tambiy tiwei lam anghei gheyapu eno la ghey en lulul sapa, de tambiy wei lam anghei tembuing eno inyon tembuing, me mi luk en lul wei tembuing o. De tambiy tiwei lam anghei tyoung gheyapu eno la ghey en lulul sapa.
Moxo mi luk en vati wei yei me ngo yo, ekom xelti se zeimaxoun e xe qayeeng.
Tambiy tiwei zeimaxoun e xe qayeeng eno talex lek bei Anutu yon zonghek ayang.
En tambiy tiwei Anutu wong e lam eno mi neil Anutu xe qayeeng, en Anutu wong Laweeng Vambuing dalus wou e.
De Ma lalei vind Neu Moux me toung lulul dalus la eivek e mema.
Xelti bongis Neu Moux on qou mapieing luta luta, ekom xelti pesek Neu Moux on tyek se gyei mapieing, en tyek Anutu xe lalei vanei detei lek e.”
